we have designed and implemented a reconfigurable componentbased problem solving environment, which allows the integration of parallel and high-performance computing components, as well as traditional calculation and data management applications, and which provides a flexible, high-performance, and easy to use environment for the integration and composition of such applications.
DISCWorld is a Java-based middleware for integrating and reconfiguring component applications across wide area networks.

(1) DISCWorld is a Java-based middleware for distributed problem solving environments; (2) DISCWorld provides a graphical interface to create task graphs and a scripting language to compose complex tasks; (3) DISCWorld allows the execution of components on heterogeneous and distributed platforms; (4) DISCWorld supports reconfigurable task subgraphs that can execute on distributed servers; (5) DISCWorld can execute pure Java implementations of operators or platform-specific supercomputer implementations of operators;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and construction of a problem solving environment that allows the integration of high performance and distributed computing components.

the design of an integration technology that allows the construction of a problem solving environment that supports the composition and execution of complex processing requests on distributed heterogeneous computing systems.

the construction of a component-based problem solving environments that allows the integration of high performance computing systems with the management and calculation tools of scientific and engineering applications.

the DISCWorld system has proven to be a very effective and flexible problem solving environment for the solution of complex problems that require the integration of a large number of components, including high performance computing resources.
DISCWorld is a reconfigurable component based problem solving environment that allows the user to compose and execute complex tasks on a variety of platforms.

the DISCWorld system provides an integrated, reconfigurable, and scalable problem solving environment that can be used to construct and execute complex scientific applications across a wide-area network.
